description: This dataset compiles 20 human-observed occurrences of the ribbon eel, Rhinomuraena quaesita, sourced from iNaturalist and aggregated via GBIF. The records span multiple countries in the Indo-Pacific region, including Indonesia, the Philippines, and Australia, with observation dates ranging from 1989 to 2026. Each entry provides precise taxonomic classification, geographic coordinates, and temporal details, though some spatial and depth data are missing. All records are licensed under Creative Commons, allowing for open research use. Researchers can utilize this collection to analyze the species' distribution patterns, habitat preferences, and seasonal occurrence trends across its native range.
